messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to add 'lumin-3b-compact@v2026-03-01' to the model catalog tomorrow. Need a deploy owner + smoke tester + rollback owner. Target window 09:30 PST (should be ~30m). Who's available? :calendar:
nico: I can take the deploy (first time doing catalog pin). Would appreciate someone pairing for smoke and rollback steps.
raj: I can shadow and own rollback readiness. Quick notes: model is 3B compact, 4-bit quant, expected footprint ~6GB. We'll pin alias after a short canary. Also prepare fallback alias.
sasha: Catalog side: ingest slot allocated (slot-42), manifest and metadata uploaded. One note — safety_review field must be set to "passed" or the ingest job will block.
jamie: SRE ok for 09:30 PST. I'll run smoke checks and watch latency/error rates. Quick checklist I'll use:

1) Health probe
2) 5 sample prompts (semantic check)
3) Latency p50/p95
4) Error rate and traces

Use this smoke script:
```
# smoke.sh
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/engines/lumin-3b/completions \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"prompt":"Summarize the plot of The Little Prince","max_tokens":32}' | jq .
```

If p50 > 150ms or errors > 1% we rollback immediately and ping @oncall + @eng-runtime. :warning:
nico: Got it. Do we have a rollback alias ready or should I create one now?
raj: I prepped fallback alias `stable-2026-02-20`. Swap command (catalog CLI):
```
redwood catalog pin lumin-3b --to stable-2026-02-20 --force
```

deploy-bot: pipeline triggered for lumin-3b-canary by nico at 3123456830 — CI: passing :white_check_mark:
jamie: After canary runs ~10m with no regressions we can promote. nico — can you run the 5 prompts and paste outputs here so we have a record?
nico: Starting now, will paste results as I run them.

jamie: Smoke results (quick summary): 5/5 semantic checks OK, latency p50=120ms p95=210ms, no generation truncation, error rate 0.0%. Token cost within expected range. Recommend promote. :thumbsup:
sasha: Catalog ingest finished and model pinned to slot-42. Publishing window open.
raj: Promoting in 2m. I'll watch for any anomaly; if anything odd I'll revert to stable alias.
deploy-bot: promotion complete at 3123456843 — alias lumin-3b -> lumin-3b/2026-03-01 :tada:
maria: Thanks all — great job. Nico — nice first deploy. I'll add a 2-paragraph note to eng-ml handbook about the steps and checklist we used. :party_parrot:
